g.data-entity: Transaction Service.nOwns transaction and transfer data
g.id: cluster_Transaction Service.nOwns transaction and transfer data

g.text: Account Service is the sole owner of account state
and balance. Other services use account IDs and
service contracts, never a cross-database JPA link.
A transfer refers to two accounts by ID.
account checks and balance changes cross the
Immutable message contract, not a JPA entity.
Published for asynchronous consumers such as
Consumers must not rely on a shared database.
Dashed links show logical references/cardinalities only.
They do not imply foreign keys or ORM relationships
